custom: Lace-up; layered panels; zip detail; sculpted sole sidewall
highlights:
Layered synthetic-leather upper: Overlapping toe, side and heel panels create a defined athletic casual profile.

Lace-up front: Eyelet rows provide an adjustable fastening, with a visible zipper detail alongside the laces.

Sculpted sole sidewall: Diagonal fins and a raised heel section give the sole a distinctive shape. The original bottom photograph shows the actual tread layout.

Collar and heel details: The low-top opening has a textured lining surface, while a rear pull loop helps grip the shoe when putting it on.

Colour-size assortment: Ivory/Navy and Black are listed in EU39-44. Send quantities, packing preference and destination for a wholesale quotation.
dedup: Exact source URL/artno checked against unique registry; not currently adopted by another family. Raw photos reviewed in full, sidebar excluded; actual markings kept, no invented material or performance.
